newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet, with most of this week's showlists sold, market sources said.
Sales this week were mostly $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, up $4.00 from last week's top prices, although there were a few loads at $112.50 on Wednesday.
On a live basis, prices ranged $69.00 to $70.00, with the higher amount paid in western Nebraska, they said.
This week's sales volume was 84,400 head, according to USDA statistics. The weekly volume was well above the estimated showlist of 73,300 head, market sources said.
